blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Regulating digital giants involves monitoring market dominance and platform neutrality in modern digital economies.
Detecting secret cartels is essential to prevent anti-competitive price-fixing and market division.
Handling cross-border mergers requires addressing complex jurisdictional overlaps and multi-agency cooperation.
Cartel Detection: Leniency regimes and whistle-blower provisions are frequently tested key tools for uncovering secret cartels.
Digital Market Regulation: Questions often focus on anti-competitive practices, self-referencing, and data monopolies in Big Tech.
Cross-Border Mergers: Focus on the extra-territorial jurisdiction principles (e.g., Effect Doctrine) applied by regulators.
